text: dsh-wsl-obsidian 是连接 WSL 中 DSH 与 Windows Obsidian vault 的工具插件。它可检查 vault、列举和搜索 Markdown 笔记、读取及更新笔记、解析 wikilinks，并在 Windows Obsidian 中打开笔记。工具使用 vault 相对路径，写入需确认。需要 WSL 和本地 vault，不需要 API key。

dsh-wsl-obsidian connects DSH in WSL to a Windows Obsidian vault. Tools check vault status, list and search Markdown notes, read or update notes, resolve wikilinks, and open notes in Obsidian. Writes require confirmation. Needs WSL and a local vault; no API key.

让 DSH 帮我解析笔记中的 wikilinks
I want to search my Obsidian notes from a DSH session in WSL
Open an Obsidian note on Windows from my WSL-based DSH session
dsh-wsl-obsidian 的功能「搜索笔记」：按不区分大小写的子串搜索 vault 中的 Markdown 内容和文件名，返回匹配路径与片段；通过 obsidian_search 提供 query。
dsh-wsl-obsidian 的功能「读写笔记」：按 vault 相对路径读取、覆盖或追加 Markdown 内容；写入和追加工具要求调用方传 confirm=true。
dsh-wsl-obsidian 的功能「列举笔记」：递归列出 vault 中的 Markdown 文件，可按子目录前缀筛选并限制返回数量。
dsh-wsl-obsidian 的功能「打开 Obsidian 笔记」：在 WSL 中通过 obsidian:// URI 请求 Windows Obsidian 打开 vault 或指定笔记。

DeepSeek Harness plugin: **WSL agent ↔ Windows Obsidian vault** — `obsidian_status` / `open` / `list` / `search` / `read` / `write` / `append`.

dsh-wsl-obsidian README · Where it sits：```mermaid
flowchart LR
  agent["dsh agent in WSL"] --> tools["obsidian_*"]
  tools --> ntfs["Vault on NTFS /mnt/c|d/..."]
  tools --> uri["obsidian:// → Windows Obsidian"]

Keep the vault on **Windows NTFS**. Opening a vault from `\\wsl$\…` breaks Obsidian’s file watcher.

dsh-wsl-obsidian README · Compatibility：| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Plugin** | `dsh-wsl-obsidian` **0.2.1** |
| **Minimum dsh** | ≥ **0.1.2** |
| **Latest verified** | See [dsh-wsl-kit Compatibility](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-kit#compatibility-2026-09) (currently **`0.2.2-rc.1`**) — single source of truth for the suite |
| **Kit set** | optional (not in `daily`) |
| **Obsidian** | Windows desktop app (install from [obsidian.md](https://obsidian.md)) |

dsh-wsl-obsidian README · Tools：| Tool | Role |
|------|------|
| `obsidian_status` | Resolve vault (`vaultPath` or `%APPDATA%\obsidian\obsidian.json`), path kind, `Obsidian.exe` |
| `obsidian_list` | List `.md` notes |
| `obsidian_search` | Case-insensitive substring search |
| `obsidian_read` | Read note |
| `obsidian_write` | Create / overwrite note |
| `obsidian_append` | Append to note |
| `obsidian_open` | `obsidian://open?vault=…&file=…` via PowerShell (WSL only) |
dsh-wsl-obsidian README · Tools：Paths are **vault-relative** (`Inbox/Note.md`). Absolute / `../` paths are rejected.

dsh-wsl-obsidian README · Config：```yaml
- id: dsh-wsl-obsidian
  name: dsh-wsl-obsidian
  config:
    enabled: true

If `vaultPath` is omitted, the plugin reads Windows `obsidian.json` through `/mnt/c/Users/…/AppData/Roaming/obsidian/`.

dsh-wsl-obsidian README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:173787247/dsh-wsl-obsidian
```

Restart `dsh web`, open a **new** session, run `obsidian_status`.

dsh-wsl-obsidian README · Layout recommendation：1. Install Obsidian on **Windows**.
2. Create/open the vault under `C:\` or `D:\` (not inside the Linux distro disk).
3. From WSL use `/mnt/c/...` or `/mnt/d/...` as `vaultPath`.
4. Optional later: Local REST API — not required for 0.1.0.
